scope: WS2 producer-domain error vocabulary. No HTTP status, retryability contract or wire schema is frozen.

proposed_domain_codes.meaning: Host-authenticated caller/service identity could not be established; distinct from authorization denial.
Known principal lacks required capability or action authority.
Closed DTO syntax, required field or canonical value constraint failed.
Inner producer DTO version is unknown or incompatible; distinct from outer envelope negotiation.
Validly parsed message or receipt binds a different workflow/task/plan/action subject.
Attempt, claim, lease, worker or owner epoch is no longer current; durable rejection, never accepted result.
Existing event/request/renewal identity reused with changed canonical subject or content digest.
Expected prior sequence/head CAS does not match current committed Control journal head.
Required source sequence/predecessor is missing, gapped or conflicting.
Required authenticated authority or trusted high-water cannot be obtained or validated; preserve precise verifier diagnostics.
Required source evidence is missing, incomplete, stale, ambiguous or cannot be independently verified.
